Use it when

4,200 becomes 10,000
For example, if your lowest eligible day has 4,200 steps, your Rest Card can add 5,800 steps, bringing it to 10,000.
Reused screens — the 4,200 example uses Video 1's calendar (IMG_7237: day 22 at 4,200, lifted to 10,000) and its impact screen (+5,800, deficit 10,800 → 5,000). The new recordings show 11,000 and 8,500 days, not 4,200.

When to save it
from 0:26.1
#050:26.1hold 9.6s05.pnglayout S2
Save it for later
If there's no eligible low-step day that can benefit from the card, or you've already cleared your contest deficit, there's no reason to use it. Save it for later!
From IMG_7239 — lowest day already 11,000: “No benefit here”, deficit 0 → 0. The cursor taps Save for later as the voice says it.
#060:35.7hold 6.9s06.pnglayout S2
Small gain? Decide
And if the benefit is very small, take a moment to decide whether you want to apply it or save it for another time.
From IMG_7240 — lowest day 8,500: the app's own warning “will add only 1500 steps… Do you still want to apply?”, with Save for later / Apply anyway.

Plan ahead? Soon
One more thing! For now, you cannot schedule or plan your rest days in advance. We're working on bringing that soon. But you can apply your Rest Card anytime to any of your previous eligible low-step days.
“Plan ahead? Soon” — the script says “We're working on bringing that soon”. Check the headline doesn't promise more than you want to; “Past days only” is an alternative.

Use your card when it can make a real difference!
Have a Rest Card in your account? Before you use it, here's when you should apply it and when you should save it for later.

Use your Rest Card when you've had a low-step day and still have a contest deficit to clear.

For example, if your lowest eligible day has 4,200 steps, your Rest Card can add 5,800 steps, bringing it to 10,000.

This can help you reduce your overall contest deficit.

If there's no eligible low-step day that can benefit from the card, or you've already cleared your contest deficit, there's no reason to use it. Save it for later!

And if the benefit is very small, take a moment to decide whether you want to apply it or save it for another time.

One more thing! For now, you cannot schedule or plan your rest days in advance. We're working on bringing that soon. But you can apply your Rest Card anytime to any of your previous eligible low-step days.

My suggestion? Always check your potential impact before applying.

Use your card when it can make a real difference!
